lines.text: David gathers thirty thousand chosen men to bring the ark from Abinadab's house on a new cart.
At the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah takes hold of the ark, and God strikes him down for his irreverence.
David fears the LORD, moves the ark into the City of David at once, and the LORD blesses Obed-edom.

wrong_details.wrong: David moves the ark into the City of David at once
wrong_details.true: David was unwilling to move the ark to the City of David and took it aside to Obed-edom's house

lines.text: The ark is carried up, David dances before the LORD in a linen ephod, and his wife Abigail despises him.
David offers sacrifices, blesses the people, and tells Michal he will humble himself even more; she has no children.
